Introduction

Ku Chang‑mo, known mononymously as CHANGMO is a South Korean rapper, vocalist, producer & multi‑instrumentalist. He debuted in the underground scene with mixtapes in 2014 (“Time to Get Money”, “Ready to Be a Star #DBJB”) and officially marked his debut with his self-produced studio album "M O T O W N" (2016). That same year, he joined Ambition Musik, the sub-label founded by Dok2 and The Quiett, which significantly boosted his exposure. He plays instruments like piano and bass, and produces nearly all his own tracks. He turned down two opportunities to attend prestigious Berklee College of Music due to financial constraints.

He made his breakout with his debut studio album "Boyhood" (2019). The albums spawned the single “METEOR", which topped charts and earned him the Best R&B/Hip-Hop Award and Hip-Hop Track of the Year at the 2020 Golden Disc Awards.

Changmo served as a producer on Show Me The Money 777 in 2018 and continued to release chart-topping projects such as "Underground Rockstar" (2021), which included singles like “Hyperstar” and “Taiji.” These tracks earned him accolades at the Korean Hip-Hop Awards and the Korean Music Awards in 2022.

After his contract with Ambition Musik ended on April 7 2025, Changmo went onto establish his indepenent label MORIENT.
